notes.title: Update v1.1.0 ~ Controller Support!
notes.notes:
With this update we added controller support for the game! 

If you have any feedback about controller support or something is not working as intended, let us know about it!

v1.1.0
Feature: Added Controller support.

Kiko

notes.title: v1.0.7 Update
notes.notes:
v1.0.7 UPDATE:

· BALANCE:  Some of the summoned enemies by the ability to summon new enemies were too weak and could be abused, so they have been changed to more powerful enemies.
· BALANCE: Cryo Fortification (Ice Paladin) skill could be abused, is now harder to use.
· BALANCE: Numerical Resilience  (IMechanoid) skill could be abused, is now harder to use.
· FIX: Pyrofrost Supression (Ice Paladin) skill has been clarified.
· FIX: Stopwatch (Mechanoid) artifact has been clarified.
· FIX: Cloud Saving is now working.
· FIX: After saving a game and restarting you could end trying to get more than 5 skills. Now the game restarts correctly.
· FIX: Skill "Cryogenic Transmutation" now rolls 2 dices.
· FIX: Summoning various enemies could cause the game to get stuck and make it impossible to end your turn.

notes.title: Right and Down and Dice demo UPDATE! v0.9.1
notes.notes:
Hello,

We just released a new demo version with some minor adjustments, this will be the final version for the Steam Fest for next week!

VERSION 0.9.1

 We added a mini boss fight in the last level of the game just before the final treasure.
 Bugfixes.
 Balancing (artifacts cost, hero skills...).


Thank you,
Kiko

notes.title: Right and Down and Dice demo UPDATE! v0.8.2
notes.notes:
Hello,

First of all, we would like to thank everyone who has tried the demo and sent us feedback!

With all the data received, we have updated the demo version of Right and Down and Dice with these changes:

VERSION 0.8.2

 The game animations are generally faster and more dynamic.
 The game difficulty has been adjusted. Overall the game should feel a little easier and with a fairer difficulty curve.
 General bugfixes (especially some interactions between artifacts and/or abilities.)


If you play the demo again let us know your opinion.

Thank you,
Kiko
